tasks.title: coconut.args — global read-only CLI args on both Lua and JS sides
tasks.description:
- argparse::Args gets positional, named, flags fields
- Convert args to nlohmann::json after parsing, store on bridge state
- Lua: coconut.args → read-only sol::table from stored JSON
- JS: inject coconut.args during bridge init (or via __get_args command)
- { positional=["file.lua"], named={mode="dev"}, flags={verbose=true} }
- No config pollution, backward-compatible, globally accessible

tasks.title: coconut.store — shared KV store (C++ map, string-only, event-driven sync)
tasks.description:
- C++ unordered_map<string,string> owned by bridge::State
- Lua: coconut.store:set(k,v)/:get(k)/:has(k)/:delete(k)/:clear()/:keys() — sync C++ calls
- JS: coconut.store.set(k,v)/.get(k)/.has(k)/.delete(k)/.clear()/.keys() — async via bridge commands
- Events: set() broadcasts 'store:update' to the other side with {key, value}
- Both sides can coconut.on('store:update', cb) to react to changes
- New module: src/store.h / src/store.cpp

tasks.title: coconut.keybind — dual-registry keybind system (JS + Lua)
tasks.description:
- JS captures keydown → normalize combo → check JS registry
- If unconsumed → emit 'keydown' event to Lua via bridge
- Lua receives via coconut.on('keydown') → check Lua registry
- API: coconut.keybind(combo, fn|cmd_name, scope?) on both sides
- Combo format: ctrl+s, cmd+shift+p, alt+f4, esc, up, down, f1..f12
- Scope: 'global' (always active) or app-defined string
- Returns unregister function
- Event payload: { key, ctrl, shift, alt, meta, scope }
- JS: keydown listener, normalization table, registry, scope management
- Lua: coconut.keybind() binding, registry table, coconut.on('keydown') handler
